_about: PatchLabs demo workspace. Fake data for /demo: no real customers, apps or people. The first app is our own demo repo; its findings beyond PL-001 on public.profiles are representative examples, not a real run.

questions_for_owner.question: Should people who aren't signed in see avatars?
questions_for_owner.recommended: Yes, if avatars appear on public pages; the files hold no other personal data.

findings.title: Anyone on the internet can read personal data
findings.evidence: policy "Profiles are viewable by everyone" FOR SELECT USING (true); columns: email, phone
findings.proof: Anonymous visitor read 2 of 2 seeded rows (email, phone). After the fix: anon 0, stranger 0, owner 1.
findings.fix: Replace the everyone-can-read policy with an owner-only SELECT (auth.uid() = user_id).

findings.title: Any signed-in user can read every row
findings.evidence: policy "Signed in users can read" FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true); columns: sender_email, body
findings.proof: Signed-in stranger read 3 messages between two other seeded users. After the fix: stranger 0, owner 2.
findings.fix: Scope SELECT to the sender or the recipient: auth.uid() IN (sender_id, recipient_id).

findings.title: Row level security is on but no policies exist
findings.evidence: ALTER TABLE public.audit_log ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; (no CREATE POLICY follows)
findings.proof: Owner read 0 of their own 4 seeded rows: nobody but the service role can read this table.
findings.fix: Add an owner-only SELECT policy if the app reads this table; otherwise leave it locked.

findings.title: UPDATE policy has no WITH CHECK
findings.evidence: CREATE POLICY "Users update own profile" FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id); -- no WITH CHECK
findings.proof: Owner changed user_id on their own row to another user's id and the update was accepted.
findings.fix: Add WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id) so a row can't be handed to someone else.

findings.title: Policy is always true
findings.evidence: CREATE POLICY "Anyone can manage feedback" FOR ALL USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
findings.proof: Anonymous visitor deleted 1 feedback row written by a seeded user.
findings.fix: Split into INSERT for anyone and SELECT/DELETE for the author only.

findings.title: SECURITY DEFINER function callable by anyone
findings.evidence: CREATE FUNCTION public.get_user_stats() ... SECURITY DEFINER; GRANT EXECUTE ... TO anon;
findings.proof: Anonymous visitor called get_user_stats() and received counts for every seeded user.
findings.fix: Revoke EXECUTE from anon, set search_path, and filter by auth.uid() inside the function.

findings.title: Storage bucket is public
findings.evidence: INSERT INTO storage.buckets (id, name, public) VALUES ('avatars', 'avatars', true);
findings.proof: Anonymous visitor listed and downloaded 2 seeded files from the avatars bucket.
findings.fix: Make the bucket private and serve files with signed URLs, or confirm avatars are meant to be public.

findings.title: Row level security is not enabled
findings.evidence: CREATE TABLE public.invoices (...); -- no ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY anywhere in the migrations
findings.proof: Anonymous visitor read 3 of 3 seeded invoices (billing_email, amount).
findings.fix: Enable row level security and add owner-only policies.

findings.title: AI, payment or database key in the code
findings.evidence: const OPENAI_API_KEY = "sk-proj-••••••••" // shipped to the browser bundle
findings.fix: Move the call behind a server-side function, then rotate the key with the provider.

findings.title: Service role key in client code
findings.evidence: const SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY = "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs…[redacted]"
findings.fix: Move the call to a server-side function, then rotate the key in the Supabase dashboard.

findings.title: Key still in git history
findings.evidence: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=sk_test_•••••••• (added in 4f2a9c1, deleted in 9b17e03)
findings.fix: Rotate the key. Deleting the file doesn't remove it from history.

findings.title: Edge function open without sign-in while using the service key
findings.evidence: createClient(url, Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY')) with no Authorization check; verify_jwt = false
findings.fix: Check the caller's JWT before using the service key, or turn verify_jwt back on.

findings.title: Sign-ups need no email confirmation
findings.evidence: [auth.email] enable_confirmations = false
findings.fix: Turn on email confirmations so nobody can sign up with someone else's address.

findings.title: Access decided by user_metadata, which users can edit
findings.evidence: if (user.user_metadata.role !== 'admin') return new Response('Forbidden', { status: 403 })
findings.fix: Decide roles from app_metadata or a roles table the user can't write to.

findings.title: Admin check only in the browser
findings.evidence: if (user.email !== ADMIN_EMAIL) return <Navigate to="/" /> // data queries below have no server-side check
findings.fix: Enforce the admin role in a policy or server function, not only in the page.

findings.title: Payment webhook doesn't verify its signature
findings.evidence: const event = await req.json(); // no stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(...)
findings.fix: Verify the Stripe-Signature header with your webhook secret before trusting the event.

findings.title: Edge function trusts a user id sent in the request
findings.evidence: const { user_id, ...fields } = await req.json(); ... .eq('id', user_id)
findings.fix: Take the user id from the verified JWT, never from the request body.

findings.title: Dependency with a known vulnerability
findings.evidence: next@14.1.0: middleware authorisation bypass (fixed in 14.2.25)
findings.fix: Upgrade next to 14.2.25 or later.

findings.title: User content rendered as raw HTML
findings.evidence: <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: comment.body }} />
findings.fix: Render as text, or sanitise with DOMPurify before inserting HTML.

findings.title: Firebase rules allow anyone
findings.evidence: match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if true; }
findings.fix: Require request.auth and match the document owner in the rules.

findings.title: Any website can call a signed-in function
findings.evidence: 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*' with 'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, ...'
findings.fix: Allow only your own site's origin.
